item.title: EplayerX 1.2.70
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 降低大型网盘媒体库批量读取识别结果时的内存占用，改善浏览和播放时的稳定性。 - 改善部分视频从上次进度继续播放、向前或向后跳转后的恢复表现。 - 改善剧集播完后切换到下一集的稳定性。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。
## What’s New
- Reduced memory use when loading recognition results for large cloud media libraries, improving stability while browsing and playing videos. - Improved playback recovery for some videos when resuming from a saved position or seeking in either direction. - Improved the transition to the next episode after the current episode finishes.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later.
